prereqs.command: command -v poetry >/dev/null || { if command -v pip >/dev/null || command -v pip3 >/dev/null; then (pip install poetry || pip3 install poetry); else apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl >/dev/null && curl -sSL https://install.python-poetry.org | POETRY_HOME=/opt/poetry python3 - && ln -sf /opt/poetry/bin/poetry /usr/local/bin/poetry; fi; }

knownFailures.cause: `poetry` is not installed; the docs assume it is.

knownFailures.signature: Error: The current project could not be installed: No file/folder found for package fastapi-boilerplate
knownFailures.cause: The dependencies installed, but current Poetry also installs the project itself, and this repo is an app, not a package. Older Poetry skipped that silently.

knownFailures.signature: sqlalchemy.exc.OperationalError: (pymysql.err.OperationalError) (2003, "Can't connect to MySQL server on 'localhost' ([Errno 111] Connection refused)")
knownFailures.cause: The app connects to MySQL on localhost:3306, but the docs never start it.
